snapshot.actual: Immutable GitHub file/blob responses held in isolated tool session state; no local snapshot, worktree, execution probe or runtime created.

candidate.comparison: Read-only source-string comparison through the original class body, excluding its closing brace; not compilation or runtime execution.

verdict: bounded no-defect; no source/test changes recommended

checks.attempt: Reuse cached pixels after invalid/blank or oversized display name, duplicate ID, incompatible schema/room, NaN or infinite metadata.
checks.finding: CacheKey first calls scene.validated(); rejected metadata produces no lookup key and follows the authoritative render path. Only accepted display names are stripped; UUIDs, array order and every other scene field remain. No bypass found.

checks.attempt: Alias a changed subject position, camera/lens, light parameter/order, exposure or white balance with a previous frame.
checks.finding: Synthesized Equatable over the scene value includes all stored properties except deliberately blanked names; no rounding or hash-only identity. Optional values and schema versions remain distinct, allowing conservative misses rather than incorrect hits.

checks.attempt: Cross-hit sphere/bust or distinct resolutions; request Int.max, Int.min, zero or nonmultiple width.
checks.finding: Key includes StudySubject and rendered width. Bust uses min(requested,144) both in key and renderer; sphere retains requested width. Invalid low/nonmultiple widths cannot have an admitted prior successful entry. Existing engine clamping is preserved.

checks.attempt: Return an old Metal frame after command/allocation/malformed-output failure coinciding with cancellation.
checks.finding: selectCPU assigns cpu and removes every backend==metal frame before the later cancellation guard; removal updates costs and retains CPU order. The actor method contains no suspension. No incompatible survivor found. Ordinary cancellation and precisionDomain keep a valid backend deliberately; failed/cancelled work never reaches retain.

checks.attempt: Let cache reuse change per-width eligibility or use normalized metadata in rendered samples.
checks.finding: Eligibility is width-aware and validates raw scene. Packer/CPU setup consumes the original scene; key normalization never mutates renderer input. CPU cancellation cadence remains eight pixels. Numerical parity was not executed.

candidate_scope.measurement_status: The candidate will render real CPU images and read cacheUsage; expected payload constants are assertions, not observed measurements.

frozen_contract.parity: 6 fixtures; exact masks; mean RGB <=1; fraction(error>4)<=0.005

evidence_limits: Source inspection, mock lifecycle results, host shared-kernel results, actual simulator Metal execution and physical measurements are distinct. This report contains only source inspection and source-string comparison.
next_action: Root integrates report/evidence and candidate tests, then executes targeted native/cache checks at the integrated revision and captures terminal results and KEYFILL_CACHE_RESOURCES rows. No redundant source changes.
mutations: Only unattached report/evidence blobs; no ref/commit, source/test, build configuration, UI, CPU oracle or global-state/handoff changes.
